key_insight: Rubric-Conditioned Self-Distillation turns structured rubric feedback into token-level guidance, reducing reliance on a single possibly noisy reference rationale.
engineering_relevance: It offers a more interpretable and fine-grained post-training signal for reasoning LMs than scalar-reward RL, which is useful when building reliable model improvement pipelines.
method: Generate task-specific rubrics in a first stage.
Condition the teacher on these rubrics to guide the student's own sampled trajectories.
Provide token-level supervision over the reasoning process instead of only final-answer or scalar reward signals.
evidence_signal: On a diverse suite of science reasoning benchmarks, the approach outperformed GRPO by 1.0 points and OPSD by 0.9 points on average.
watch_item: The method depends on the quality of generated rubrics and on-policy trajectories, so weak rubric generation or mis-specified criteria could still steer training poorly.
